subject: SOURCE FORMAT directive
notes: kb/Work PB1067 (w67m): the normalizer records a ReferenceFormatMap per text (the compilation group's registered by Frontend, each library text's by CopyProcessor); ResolveOneCopy looks the COPY statement's origin line up in the map of the text it is written in and starts the library text in that format (golden leg [LIB-FREE]: a copybook copied from free-form text is free). Determination (docs/CONFORMANCE.md): the compilation group's format, when no SOURCE directive states it, is DETECTED (documented extension over GR2, DEVLOG 931); a text detected fixed hands fixed on, a text detected free (no column structure — seven-space indentation is legal in both) hands nothing on and the library text is detected on its own.
